versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-douyin-public-data-fetcher.
- Supports four major features: keyword search (video/image/user), bulk creator post fetching, video comment analysis, and real-time trending queries.
- Includes precise trigger rules and parameter mapping from natural language for robust intent recognition.
- Built-in error handling with strict output controls for invalid tokens and API limits.
- CLI tools provided for all data types; output in JSON for direct consumption.
- Security-focused: API token required by environment variable, never logged or exposed.
